title: Kubernetes 1.29 Native Sidecars: Jobs That Finish, Ordered Shutdown and the 1.28 Trap
excerpt: Kubernetes 1.29 turns on native sidecars. Seven scenarios on kind: Jobs now complete, shutdown runs main first and then sidecars in reverse, a slow main container can starve a log shipper of its grace period, and on 1.28 the same manifest hangs in Init.
